correctness.evidence: The explicit point set/code data are consistent with an (17,3)-arc and the committed search supports fixed-conic maximality.

originality.evidence: Dönmez-Akpınar-Pelen arXiv:2608.18192 explicitly records that for q=9 a conic extends to maximal size 17, citing Marcugini-Milani-Pambianco 2001/2002 classifications of NMDS codes over GF(9). The headline existence/maximality is therefore not new.

value.evidence: The remaining explicit witness, enumerator and stabilizer data are ancillary to a historically classified parameter set and are not shown to distinguish a previously unknown equivalence class.
